description: Semantic acceptance and rejection cases for a Genesis producer-signed creator leaf binding, recipient-Station-signed historical Add attestations, governance-Station-signed complete roster manifest and RFC-tree-only leaf index recovery. No placeholder signature is presented as a cryptographic KAT; the named runner must construct and verify real accepted signatures and MLS public material.

cases.given: Cross-Station joined Bob requests accepted Genesis GroupInfo/tree through self member material read; his Account Station checks session Actor and current/target membership and governance repeats the dual-cut check on the forwarded exact caller

expected.decision: accept only with matching accepted Genesis selectors, both content-addressed raw-byte digests and RFC public tree; no peer credential is exposed to the device

cases.name: cross_station_member_public_material_read

cases.given: The member has left currently, lacked target-cut history, changes caller_actor_id or target Commit, requests a hidden Circle, or points to unavailable or inconsistent Genesis Blob bytes

expected.decision: unauthorized and unknown return indistinguishable not_found; authorized material failure returns revision_unavailable; no partial bytes, private tree, secret or inferred leaf index

cases.name: member_public_material_fail_closed

cases.given: Genesis producer key and MLS leaf signature key differ, but signed creator_leaf_authority binds the exact public-tree leaf, endpoint and accepted historical authorization

expected.decision: accept; no equality with Event producer key is inferred or required

cases.name: genesis_explicit_distinct_key_accept

expected.decision: schema_violation; zero Event, Commit and group-state writes

cases.given: Signed creator binding names a different leaf key, endpoint or historical authorization than the verified public tree and producer authority
cases.name: genesis_wrong_key_or_authorization_reject

cases.given: winning Add Commit and Welcome are accepted, but recipient replica has not delivered its signed authority attestation

expected.decision: Commit remains accepted; authorized roster read returns only revision_unavailable with no partial records

cases.name: remote_add_before_attestation_unavailable

cases.given: recipient Station has atomically persisted a signed exact-Commit/Welcome/claim attestation and outbox after existing replica verification; governance verifies full claim outcome and frozen Proposal provenance

expected.decision: first peer attest returns installed; exact replay returns duplicate with identical digest; complete authorized roster read succeeds

cases.name: verified_attestation_installs_and_replays

cases.given: wrong Station signer, claim receipt digest, actor, endpoint, leaf key, Commit, Welcome, scope or epoch

expected.decision: peer attest rejects with zero proof writes; roster read remains revision_unavailable

cases.name: forged_or_mismatched_attestation_reject

cases.given: Remove and later Add restore identical ActorId, credential, signature key and RFC leaf position

expected.decision: roster record uses the later creating Commit/Proposal and signed Add attestation; removed provenance is not reused

cases.name: same_tuple_remove_add_keeps_new_provenance

cases.given: caller was a member at target cut but is no longer current joined, or cannot read target scope/history

expected.decision: self and peer roster read expose no records, counts or proof availability; same not_found as unknown selector

cases.name: former_member_and_hidden_scope_not_found

cases.given: page omitted, repeated, reordered or from another authority head/caller/target cut, or complete JCS digest differs

expected.decision: client rejects entire roster, installs no leaf bindings; governance fails cursor on a changed current head

cases.name: page_digest_or_cut_change_reject

cases.given: epoch 0 roster read names Genesis as both target and authority head; later cuts enumerate Genesis then every historical Add by accepted Commit stream position and consumed Proposal wire order, eight records per nonfinal page

expected.decision: manifest page_count and SHA-256 JCS digest match the complete ordered array; page reassembly is deterministic

cases.name: genesis_cut_and_deterministic_pages

cases.given: claim_outcome contains duplicate claim_id, or signed claims_digest matches but selected record does not hash to attestation.claim_record_digest

expected.decision: peer attest rejects with zero proof writes; roster read remains revision_unavailable

cases.name: claim_record_digest_and_uniqueness_reject

cases.given: provider returns leaf_index, private tree, MLS secret or an unclaimed batch KeyPackage in a roster page

expected.decision: closed schema rejects; client derives occupied leaf indices only from digest-verified RFC GroupInfo/tree

cases.name: no_inferred_leaf_index_or_private_material
